additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368445-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312567479/17] Outlets unavailable CRM:00643000807
additional_info.body:
Hi Florent,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding your query, there is no issue with the charging session. This is an internal communication to SECC lost for a small interval of time. Our charger will reconnect to SECC within 5 seconds. While SECC is not reachable, an out-of-order flag will be active and will be cleared as soon as the Si-D reconnects to SECC. Our team is working on improving connectivity. As the charging session are not hampered due to this, the issue is self-cleared within 5 seconds. If there is major unavailability of the outlets, please let us know. I hope your query has been answered. If there are no further questions, I suggest we proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
